title: Ada and the Trail
author: Sable Thackeray
blurb: Beatrix Dravenmoor, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
